items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Gladys called me the next day. She said, Arnett, you need a horn, don't you? I said yes.

ctx.x: But his wife joined in, and they all cussed Gladys out, both of them. So Gladys forgot him. Now, I'm having trouble with my horn. Lucky comes up to the Audubon Ballroom up on 166th Street and Audubon, near the Medical Center. And he done sold his horn and come to play Hamp's job with a clarinet. And Hamp said, ch-ch-ch-ch (inaudible). He said, well, I'm going to play clarinet until I get my tenor.

Gladys called me the next day. She said, Arnett, you need a horn, don't you? I said yes. She said, Go to Mannings and try that horn out and see if you like it. That's where Lucky was getting it. If you like it, call me up at home. Give my right hand to God.
